title: Your Tent Can't Open After DARK ⛺
description:
At our lake, once your tent is zipped at dark, you can't open it for anyone, because whatever is outside sounds like whoever you love.

My cousin Dev and I camp there every August. This year, at two in the morning, the zipper started to move.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment MOOSE if you'd have asked for the joke first.
